idea: Two opposed arms of frost blades wound along a spiral that turns as it spreads outward from the caster, so the skill draws as a vortex rather than a ring, a starburst or a crack.
intent: Two opposed arms of pale ice-blue frost blades climb out of the ground along a turning spiral, short at the caster's eye and taller and longer at the rim, with cold mist lifting along them and a brief glowing orb at the eye; power raises and lengthens the blades, winds the spiral tighter and spins it faster, on the same 27 parts.
requests: A painted frost-crystal or rime texture of our own for the airborne motes, so the cold reads as crystalline rather than as a soft smoke puff (Puff, rbxassetid://114237359953780, stands in).
